app.connect.intro: This lets Claude (in the Claude Desktop app or in Claude Code) browse the series in the open folder, view slices and take measurements on its own.
app.connect.manual: Or paste it manually in Claude Desktop → Settings → Developer → Edit Config:
app.connect.no_folder: Open a study folder first – its path goes into the configuration.
app.connect.privacy_note: Images Claude looks at are sent to Anthropic like any other conversation content. Claude can make mistakes – this does not replace the radiologist's report.
app.connect.share_patient: Share the patient's personal data with Claude (name, ID number, institution)
app.connect.share_patient_tip: Off by default: Claude only sees sex and age.
app.connect.title: Connect to Claude (MCP)
app.connect.translocated: The app is running from a temporary location. Move “MRI Viewer” to the Applications folder and open it again.
app.dialog.choose_export_folder: Choose a folder for the series images
app.dialog.choose_study_folder: Choose the study folder (e.g. a copy of the disc)
app.help.disclaimer: This tool is for information only and is not intended for diagnosis – only the radiologist's report is authoritative.
app.help.measurements_text: Choose a tool (e.g. {tool}) and drag across the image. Click a measurement to select it: you can move it, drag its ends or delete it with the Delete key or the right mouse button. Cmd/Ctrl+Z undoes a change. Measurements are approximate and are kept separately for each slice.
app.help.mouse.double_click_action: reset view (on an arrow: edit its label)
app.help.mouse.drag_measurement: Drag a measurement or one of its ends
app.help.planes_text: Axial – slices viewed from the feet (the patient's right is on the left of the screen). Sagittal – side view. Coronal – front view. Letters at the edges: R/L – right/left, A/P – anterior/posterior, S/I – superior/inferior.
app.help.pro_mode_text: Adds angle measurement, ROIs with mean intensity and area, a pixel probe, a 3D cursor, color maps, exact window/level values, a DICOM tag panel and histogram, and coordinates in mm.
app.help.step_open: 1. Open a study folder (File → Open Study Folder…, or drag the folder onto the window).
app.help.step_scroll: 3. Scroll through the slices with the mouse wheel, the arrow keys or the slider at the bottom of the image.
app.help.step_series: 2. Pick a series on the left. A series is a set of images acquired with one scanner setting (e.g. T1, T2, STIR) in one plane.
app.info.histogram_note: Value range {min} … {max}. The blue area is the current window (W {w}, L {c}).
app.info.sequence_note: TR/TE – sequence timings; short TR and TE usually mean T1-weighted images, long ones T2-weighted. STIR/FLAIR suppress the signal from fat or fluid.
app.sidebar.burned_in_tip: A screenshot, scanned document or annotated image. Claude won't see it over MCP unless you turn on showing patient data.
app.sidebar.no_dicom: No DICOM images found in this folder.
app.sidebar.no_dicom_hint: Make sure you choose the folder copied from the disc, not, for example, just the viewer program that came on it.

view.tool_hint.angle: Click three points: first arm, vertex, second arm (A)
view.tool_hint.arrow: Drag from the point of interest, then type a label (T)
view.tool_hint.cursor3d: Click a point – the other views jump to the slice through it (X)
view.tool_hint.ellipse: Drag to outline an oval region – shows approximate mean intensity and area (E)
view.tool_hint.line: Drag from point to point to measure the approximate distance in mm (M)
view.tool_hint.pan: Drag to move the image; the right mouse button always pans (P)
view.tool_hint.probe: Click to read a pixel value (V)
view.tool_hint.rect: Drag to outline a rectangular region (O)
view.tool_hint.window: Drag left/right for contrast, up/down for brightness (W)
view.tool_hint.zoom: Drag up or down to zoom; Cmd/Ctrl + scroll wheel works too (Z)
